items.title: Stockholm’s Green Voltis raises €13.5 million to operate and trade battery storage across European power markets using AI
items.summary: Green Voltis, a Stockholm-based route-to-market (RTM) optimiser that uses AI to operate and trade battery storage across European power markets, has raised €13.5 million in a Series A round, with Lochpine Capital as the sole investor. items.title: Barcelona’s Kabilio raises €10 million to deploy its AI accounting agent as client base nears 500 firms
items.summary: Kabilio, a Barcelona-based startup building an AI platform for accounting firms and the small businesses they serve, has closed a €10 million funding round. The round was led by Picus Capital and Visionaries; they also led Kabilio’s pre-Seed round.
